thread:
deploy-bot: scheduling controlled feature-flag rollout for release v2.5.1 - flag `route.prefer_fast_batcher`. Canary region: us-east-1. Window: 02:00-04:00 UTC. Steps: 0% -> 4% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m observation between steps. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ff-route-prefer-fast-batcher :rocket:

marta: ack. request we pin routing model to remove model variance during 4%/25% checks. command to apply before canary: `deployctl pin service=llm-router version=2026-05-01-a --reason="canary stability"`

lee: agreed. also suggest a KV warmup ~9m prior to 4% using the tops-of-day prefixes. script: `./tools/warm_kv --model 2026-05-01-a --prefix-file telemetry/top1000.txt --concurrency 6 --duration 9m`

omar: proposed automated rollback thresholds: 5m error_rate > 1.2% OR p95 latency delta > 180ms vs baseline OR queue_saturation > 2.5x. Auto-action: set flag to 0% and notify #eng-incidents. Manual follow-up: unpin after metrics stable for 20m.

sarah: I'll add temporary alerts and enable 1% trace sampling for canary traffic. Also add a short log filter for OOMs and kernel GPU errors in llm-router.

marta: apply a soft lock on this flag for the window: `deployctl lock ff=route.prefer_fast_batcher window=02:00-04:00UTC` to prevent concurrent edits.

ops-bot: preflight checks started: ci=ok, infra=green, capacity_us-east-1=ok. Runbook validated. rollout_id=rl-20260501-9.

lee: warming KV at T-9m. will update when cache hit >95%. also temporarily reduce batcher.max_delay_ms to 5ms in canary region to reduce tail noise: `service.llm-router.batcher.max_delay_ms=5`

lee: warmup complete — prefix cache=96%. pin applied to 2026-05-01-a. starting 4% canary now.

deploy-bot: 4% applied at 2867891320. monitoring window open. tagging @marta @lee @omar @sarah.

omar: initial metrics look stable; minor p95 bump +25ms. no error alerts currently.

sarah: traces are flowing. temp alert thresholds in place. will escalate to #eng-incidents if any breach.

marta: release notes line ready: "Enabled route.prefer_fast_batcher (staged). Pinned llm-router=2026-05-01-a for canary. Performed KV warmup pre-canary. Auto-rollback thresholds enabled." will include rollout_id rl-20260501-9 in changelog.

ops-bot: preflight summary: pin, warmup, locks, alerts all applied. ready to progress to 25% per schedule if no alerts by next check.
